posts.content:
Another great visibility hack for your SaaS is to get listed on the EmDash plugin registry (DR 76). You get a dedicated page with a dofollow link to your website.

Massive shout-out to @apexmarketinguk  for sharing it with me

Here is how:

1. Scaffold a plugin: pnpm dlx @ emdash-cms/plugin-cli init my-plugin
2. Build something simple that connects EmDash to your SaaS, like sharing a post when an entry is published (ask Claude to build it for you).
3. Set author.url in the manifest to your website. That's the dofollow link on your page.
4. Run emdash-plugin login with a Bluesky account, then emdash-plugin publish.

That's it. No form, no review queue. The registry runs automated checks and your page goes live at plugins.emdashcms .com/plugins/@<you>/<plugin>.

A few notes:

EmDash is Cloudflare's new CMS, and its registry has only a handful of plugins so far.

Use a Bluesky account with your domain as the handle. Your listing then reads @ yourdomain. com instead of @ yourname .bsky.social.
posts.author: Taras
posts.notes: 在 EmDash plugin registry（plugins.emdashcms.com）用 CLI scaffold 简单插件连接 SaaS，设置 manifest author.url 为网站，用 Bluesky 账号 login 并 publish，得到 DR76 dofollow 专用页面外链（无审核队列）。
